title: About {{marca}}
subtitle: A platform that connects owners, walkers and businesses around pet care.

whatIs.title: What it is
whatIs.body: {{marca}} connects pet owners with verified walkers in their area, centralizes each pet's health history, and helps the community report and reunite with lost pets. All from a single account, no matter which role you sign in with.

owners.texto: Register your pets with their vaccine history, find verified walkers in your area and track every walk in real time.

walkers.texto: Post your availability, receive requests from nearby owners and manage your schedule and earnings in one place.

businesses.texto: Vets, stores and shelters show up in their area's directory so the community can find them easily.

verifiedWalkers.texto: Every profile goes through a document review before it can receive requests.

byZone.texto: You search for, and get found by, walkers, businesses and lost-pet reports near you.

lostPetsNetwork.texto: Location-tagged reports and community sightings to reunite pets faster.
